newsitem.title: USA: MGM names Nathanson president of pictures unit.
newsitem.headline: MGM names Nathanson president of pictures unit.

text.p: Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer Inc on Tuesday named production executive Michael Nathanson to the post of president and chief operating officer of MGM Pictures.
Nathanson replaces Michael Marcus who resigned last week.

MGM said Nathanson has nearly 20 years of production experience, most recently as chairman and chief executive officer of New Regency Productions and previously as President of Worldwide Production and Executive Vice President at Sony Corp's Columbia Pictures.
In September, MGM was bought by a partnership between billionaire Kirk Kerkorian and Australian media conglomerate Seven Networks Limited.
Kerkorian owns a controlling stake in MGM Grand Inc and his investment firm Tracinda Corp is partnered with Seven Networks in the ownership of MGM Inc.
